container_digest_u_reason: (U) the engine ran from an enroot container created out of a local squashfs image, which carries no registry digest. Consequence: the framework_version string above is the only handle on the engine build, and a release-candidate development build is not a stable one.

notes.cold_start_measurement: Wall clock from the launch command to the first HTTP 200 on /v1/models, polled every 5 s, so the ready instant is bracketed to within 5 s and the figure is an upper bound by up to that much. It covers the whole path a restart actually pays: weight load of 62.5 GB from the shared parallel filesystem, then the 72.3 s the engine log attributes to init (profile, KV allocation, warmup). Two things it is not. It is not a cold cache: this checkpoint had been served from the same filesystem minutes earlier, so the WekaFS client and page cache were warm, and a genuinely cold read would be slower. And it is not a scheduler-managed start: nothing here queued for an allocation, so a Slurm deployment must add its own queueing time on top.
